name: ui-ux-pro-max
title_zh: 79 套风格库直接搜，界面设计不再从零拍脑袋
tagline_zh: 做界面时不用再翻 Dribbble 碰运气——内置 79 套风格、192 组产品配色与推理档案。
tagline_en: Stop hunting Dribbble for inspiration. Search 79 styles, 192 palettes & reasoning profiles to ground your UI.
desc_en: UI/UX design intelligence for web, mobile, and desktop. This skill should be used when designing, building, reviewing, or fixing interfaces, including pages, components, design systems, accessibility, interaction, responsive layout, typography, color, charts, and stack-specific UI implementation. Searchable local data: 79 searchable styles (50 active), 192 product palettes and reasoning profiles,
why_zh: 不是泛泛的审美建议，而是把风格、配色、推理档案做成可检索的本地数据，让设计决策有据可依。
why_en: It's not vague taste advice—it's a searchable local knowledge base of styles, palettes, and rationale, turning UI decisions into.
limit_zh: 只覆盖 UI/UX 设计决策与实现指导，不生成完整设计稿或代码；需要你有基础设计工具或代码环境；风格库偏产品界面。
limit_en: Covers UI/UX decision support only; no full mockups or code. Requires your own design or dev setup. Geared to product interfaces, not.
title_en: Search 79 UI styles for design decisions, not guesswork
